name: Nightly run
title: Nightly run: the nightly feature run itself, with its own built-in instructions, its schedule and switch, its nights and what each built, and its rules

permissions: starts one run a night that changes Rouh's own code and lands it, on by default; with no workspace task it follows its built-in instructions (rouh/nightly_feature_run.md)

pauses, resumes and moves the nightly feature run's own scheduled row, and starts a night at once when the person presses Start a night now; the night's caps (100 dollars, two sign-ups) are as they were
explains itself once, the first time it has run, on the owner's screen, with Pause it
jobs: the nightly feature run, daily at 04:30 on the owner's clock
touches.remove: Delete this manifest, rouh/nightly_feature.py and rouh/nightly_feature_run.md with every caller of nightly_feature (runtime.py's job and watch, the rouh MCP server's nightly tools, Mutations' bring-in), rouh/web/nightly_run.py, nightlyrunpage.js and app/nightly_first.js, its page in evolutionpage.js and its addresses, its item in rouh/lean.py, and the line in rouh/web/clock.py that leaves the nightly row off Clockwork.
